{
  "name": "cockpit",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "description": "Claude Code status line plugin: context %, session cost, budget, context and rate-limit alerts, /cockpit dashboard with rate limits, burn rate and MCP health, and an rm -rf guard for Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, OneDrive and your own protected folders.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "budget": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Cost alert (USD)",
      "description": "Show one pop-up when the session's cost reaches this many US dollars (the dashboard's cost turns red too); 0 turns it off",
      "default": 5
    },
    "contextAlert": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Context alert (%)",
      "description": "Show one pop-up when the context window reaches this percent full, again after a /compact brings it back under; 0 turns it off",
      "default": 80
    },
    "rateAlert": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Rate-limit alert (%)",
      "description": "Show one pop-up per rate-limit window (such as the 5-hour limit) when it reaches this percent used, with its reset time; 0 turns it off",
      "default": 90
    },
    "guardPaths": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Protected folders",
      "description": "Extra folders where recursive deletes are blocked, split by ';' (e.g. ~/work; /Volumes/NAS). The guard treats them like synced folders but does not warn about installs there",
      "default": ""
    },
    "desktopSync": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Guard ~/Desktop and ~/Documents",
      "description": "Treat ~/Desktop and ~/Documents as cloud-synced folders. Turn on if macOS iCloud Drive 'Desktop & Documents Folders' (or OneDrive folder backup) syncs them",
      "default": false
    },
    "compactTools": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Compact read-only tool rows",
      "description": "Shrink the rows of finished Read calls (and Glob/Grep, on builds that have them) to one dim line",
      "default": true
    },
    "projectTags": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project tags",
      "description": "Optional labels for projects, as needle=Label pairs split by ';' (e.g. acme=Acme Corp; client-x=Client X). A project whose full path contains a needle (any letter case) shows its label in the status line, pane and spinner",
      "default": ""
    }
  },
  "author": {
    "name": "Izzatullah Mustafa",
    "url": "https://github.com/izzatum"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#readme",
  "license": "MIT",
  "repository": "https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "statusline",
    "status-line",
    "context-window",
    "token-usage",
    "session-cost",
    "cost-tracking",
    "budget-alert",
    "rate-limits",
    "dashboard",
    "mcp-health",
    "rm-rf",
    "cloud-sync",
    "dropbox",
    "icloud",
    "google-drive",
    "onedrive",
    "safety-hook",
    "context-alert",
    "rate-limit-alert"
  ]
}
